description: Prices one 4OVER4 print product live (business cards, flyers, postcards, banners, stickers or any other) for a quantity, size, paper, finish and turnaround; use it when someone asks what a print job costs or which options it has. For a quantity ladder use price_breaks; for dates use delivery_by_zip. Requires the product slug. Returns the live total and per-piece price, sizes, quantity tiers, turnarounds, options, an order link and a cart link, shown as 4OVER4's own configurator card with its photo; show that card instead of building another form. Customer phrases: "how much for 500 glossy business cards", "16pt postcards in 3 days".

attributes.description: Option choices: each key is an option group label and each value is a string from that group's choices in the options field of a result, e.g. {"Ink Color": "4/4", "Paper Type": "16pt Gloss Cover", "Rounded Corners": "Yes"}.

mailing.description: true prices direct mail and Every Door Direct Mail options, postage included.

size.description: Size in inches as width x height, e.g. 4x6 or 2x3.5; a round size is its diameter both ways plus circle, e.g. 2x2 circle.

slug.description: Product slug, from the slug field of a show_products, recommend or find_similar_products result, e.g. standard-business-cards. A category slug such as business-cards prices its main product.

name: configure_product

data.description: The live price (total and per piece) for the chosen quantity, size, options and turnaround, plus sizes, quantity tiers, turnarounds and options.

link.description: The page on www.4over4.com to continue on: order, upload and checkout happen there.

summary.description: The facts of the result in plain sentences.

title: Price a 4OVER4 print product
